title: The 8 Best Marking Gauge 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for marking gauge 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at marking gauge 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: iGaging 34-708 Wheel 3-in-1 Marking Gauge with Mortise Gauge
products.blurb: Key specs: Wheel cutter, 1/32 inch and 1mm scale, Combined mortise gauge.
strengths: Wheel cutter severs wood fibers across and with the grain -- cleaner line than pin gauges
Dual 1/32-inch and 1mm scale reads precisely without conversion
Combines a wheel marking gauge and a mortise gauge in one tool
One of the most consistently recommended affordable wheel gauges among hand tool woodworkers
limitations: Fit and finish is a step below premium boutique gauges
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: iGaging 34-777 Ebony Marking/Mortise Gauge
products.blurb: Key specs: Double-pinned mortise side, Single-pin marking side, Ebony and brass body.
strengths: Double-pinned side marks both sides of a mortise in one pass -- the fastest mortise layout tool
Adjustable spacing between the two pins for different mortise widths
Solid ebony and brass construction is the premium standard for a traditional-style marking gauge
Reversible single-pin side for standard marking gauge use
limitations: Higher price than basic beechwood gauges
Dual-function layout is specialized -- a single cutter gauge also performs this function with two passes
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: General Tools Multi-Functional Marking Gauge, Aluminum Alloy
products.blurb: Key specs: Aluminum alloy body, 360-degree rotating wheel, Laser-engraved markings.
strengths: Aluminum alloy body resists moisture-related movement that affects wooden gauges
360-degree rotating wheel locks in place for replicating markings in multiple locations
Laser-engraved markings stay legible longer than printed scales
The correct gauge for shop environments where humidity variation is significant
limitations: Not a traditional wheel-cutter gauge -- it scribes rather than severing fibers
Some woodworkers prefer the feel of a wood fence against the workpiece

products.name: Big Horn 26018 8 Inch Marking Gauge, Beechwood
products.blurb: Key specs: Traditional pin gauge, Kiln-dried beechwood, Plastic thumbscrew lock.
strengths: The traditional pin marking gauge design used in woodworking for over a century
Simple, reliable design with no complexity
One of the lowest price functional marking gauges available
The correct starter gauge for woodworkers learning layout before investing in wheel gauges
limitations: Pin cutters tear wood fibers rather than severing them -- rougher line than wheel gauges
Pin marks on end grain require a separate mortise gauge for accurate joinery layout

products.name: Crown 135 Marking Gauge, Beech
products.blurb: Key specs: UK made, Kiln-dried beech body, Plain head.
strengths: Crown is a well-established Sheffield, UK tool maker with a strong hand tool reputation
Kiln-dried beech wood body is stable and traditional
Simple, repairable pin gauge design with no complexity to break
The correct mid-price upgrade from a bare-bones starter gauge
limitations: Pin cutter is less clean than a blade or wheel cutter
Less precision adjustment than a micro-adjust wheel gauge
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Crown Tools 152 Mortise and Marking Gauge, Rosewood
products.blurb: Key specs: UK made, Mortise and marking combined, Kiln-dried rosewood.
strengths: UK made mortise and marking gauge at a lower price than premium boutique brands
Traditional rosewood fence and beam with a brass thumbscrew
Combines mortise gauge and standard marking gauge functions in one tool
Crown tools are well reviewed in the UK hand tool community
limitations: Pin-based mortise gauge, not a wheel cutter
Less available in North America than major US brands

products.name: Big Horn 19562 Mortise Marking Gauge with Knurled Brass Adjusting Screw
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual-pin mortise side, Single-pin marking side, Knurled brass adjusting screw.
strengths: Dual-pin side scribes both shoulder lines of a mortise in one pass -- registers on the reference face
Single-pin reverse side handles standard marking gauge duties from the same tool
Knurled brass adjusting screw allows fast, repeatable pin-spacing changes
The most efficient two-in-one gauge for narrow mortise and tenon layout
limitations: More expensive than a single-function pin gauge
Specialized dual-pin design is less flexible than a wheel gauge for freeform layout

products.name: Big Horn 19256 Marking Gauge, 9-Inch with Knurled Brass Adjusting Screw
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact 9-inch beam, Polished hardwood body, Brass-plated head and shaft.
strengths: Compact size fits in an apron pocket and works in tight spaces
Brass-plated head and shaft resist wear at the fence and beam contact points
Short beam is less prone to flexing than long beams
Low price makes it practical to keep as a dedicated secondary gauge
limitations: 9-inch beam limits maximum setting versus a full-length gauge
Pin cutter rather than a wheel or blade cutter

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
